about: Real-looking tickets and what the Velo support team decided. Expected values follow the team's practice, not the option descriptions.

input.subject: Charged twice
input.body: I ordered a helmet last week (A-2001) and my card was charged twice. Please fix this.

input.subject: Invoice missing
input.body: I need an invoice for order A-2002 for my employer. Can you send it?

input.subject: Where is my bike?
input.body: Order A-2003 was supposed to arrive last week. The tracking link hasn't changed in 6 days.

input.subject: Race on Saturday
input.body: My race is on Saturday and the wheelset from order A-2004 still hasn't arrived. Please help!

input.subject: Cancel my order
input.body: Please cancel order A-2005, I ordered the wrong size. It hasn't shipped yet.

input.subject: Return unused jacket
input.body: The rain jacket doesn't fit. It's unused, still with tags. How do I return it and get my money back?

input.subject: Refund not received
input.body: I sent back the pedals three weeks ago and still have no refund.

input.subject: Brakes squeak
input.body: My new Velo City 3 squeaks loudly when I brake. Is that normal?

input.subject: Brakes don't work
input.body: The rear brake on my e-bike stopped working completely on the way to work. I can't ride it.

input.subject: Wrong brake pads
input.body: The brake pads from order A-2010 don't fit my Velo City 3. Which ones do I need?

input.subject: Frame cracked
input.body: There's a crack in the frame near the bottom bracket. The bike is 2 years old. Is that covered by warranty?

input.subject: Warranty claim: motor
input.body: The motor of my e-bike makes a grinding noise since yesterday. The bike is 14 months old. I'd like a refund or a replacement.

input.subject: Defective light, return
input.body: The front light I got with order A-2013 flickers and then goes off. I want to return it.

input.subject: Error 503
input.body: My e-bike display shows error 503 and the motor won't assist. I commute every day.

input.subject: Assembly help
input.body: The bike arrived 90% assembled. How do I attach the handlebar correctly?

input.subject: Battery range in winter
input.body: My battery range drops a lot now that it's cold. Is the battery broken?

input.subject: Which frame size?
input.body: I'm 1.82 m tall with an inside leg of 86 cm. Which frame size of the Velo City 3 should I order?

input.subject: Price of the pannier bag
input.body: How much does the rear pannier bag cost, and is it in stock?

input.subject: Discount for clubs?
input.body: We're a cycling club with 12 members. Do you offer a discount if we all order the same jersey?

input.subject: City bike or e-bike?
input.body: I have a 12 km commute with one steep hill. Would you recommend an e-bike or a regular city bike?

input.subject: Kids bike
input.body: My daughter is 7. Which of your kids bikes would fit her?

input.subject: Price match
input.body: I saw the Velo City 3 for 60 euros less at another shop. Do you match prices before I order?

input.subject: Rechnung fehlt
input.body: Für Bestellung A-2023 habe ich keine Rechnung bekommen. Können Sie sie mir schicken?

input.subject: Kette springt
input.body: Seit gestern springt die Kette bei jedem zweiten Gang. Ich kann so nicht zur Arbeit fahren.

input.subject: Welche Größe?
input.body: Ich bin 1,68 m groß. Welche Rahmengröße empfehlen Sie für das Velo City 3?

input.subject: Paid but not confirmed
input.body: I paid by bank transfer four days ago but order A-2026 still says 'awaiting payment'.

input.subject: Change delivery address
input.body: Can you ship order A-2027 to my office instead? It hasn't shipped yet.

input.subject: Spare tube size
input.body: Which inner tube size do I need for my Velo City 3? I'd like to buy two.

input.subject: Loose thing at the back
input.body: Something at the back of my bike rattles since I hit a pothole. Not sure what it is.

input.subject: Tyre punctured, tour tomorrow
input.body: I have a puncture and leave for a bike tour tomorrow morning. Can you tell me how to fix it tonight?
